We are looking to support our rapidly growing team as soon as possible: Doctoral Researcher / PhD Candidate in Immunotherapy of Viral Infections (f/m/x)

Institute of Virology - Laboratory of Experimental lmmunology
TV-L: 25 h/week (64,94%)
Fixed-term employment for 3 years under the German Academic Fixed-Term Contract Act (WissZeitVG) for the purpose of pursuing a doctoral degree (PhD)
Your salary will be based on TV-L

Your tasks

• Contribute to research projects investigating broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs) to effectively target HIV-1 in vivo
• Design and evaluate AAV-based gene vector strategies for in vivo delivery of bNAb combination therapy
• Establish multispecific antibody-derived protein constructs to target the HIV-1 envelope protein
• Investigate bNAb expression, antibody-mediated virus neutralization in vitro and in vivo, and pathways of viral immune escape
• Plan, perform, and analyze experiments under scientific supervision using state-of-the-art approaches in immunology, virology, and molecular biology
• Establish, optimize, and apply immunological and virological assays, including cell culture, flow cytometry, ELISA, neutralization assays, molecular cloning, and next-generation sequencing
• Perform experiments using infectious viral material in vitro and in vivo (humanized mice) in biosafety level S3 environments
• Collaborate with national and international research partners in an interdisciplinary research environment
• Present research findings at scientific meetings and conferences, and prepare scientific manuscripts
• Maintain detailed experimental records and ensure high standards of scientific quality, reproducibility, and documentation

Your profile

• Excellent university degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in biology, biomedicine, immunology, virology, molecular medicine, or a related life science discipline
• Strong interest in translational research at the interface of immunology, virology, and infectious diseases
• Hands-on experience with immunological and molecular biology methods (e.g., cell culture, flow cytometry, ELISA, PCR, cloning, or sequencing technologies) as well as experience working with small animal models are advantageous
• Willingness to conduct experiments using HIV-1-infected humanized mouse models (existing FELASA certification is beneficial)
• Prior experience in virology, antibody research, B cell biology, or HIV research is beneficial but not required
• Independent, structured, and detail-oriented approach to scientific work based on high personal scientific standards
• High level of motivation to independently address complex scientific questions and develop creative as well as innovative solutions for scientific problems
• Strong teamwork and communication skills, as well as enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international research environment
• Excellent written and spoken English

Our offer

• Participation in a highly modern and internationally connected research project with strong scientific and societal relevance
• An excellent scientific environment within a dynamic and interdisciplinary team
• Access to state-of-the-art technologies and laboratory infrastructure within the new “Translational Research for Infectious Diseases and Oncology (TRIO)” research center
• Close scientific supervision and support for your professional and personal development
• Opportunities to participate in national and international conferences and to publish scientific findings
• Challenging and diverse responsibilities with a high degree of independence and creative freedom
• For further information, please visit www.klein-lab.de
 
Your future with us

We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail

We are a dedicated translational research group focused on understanding the fundamentals of human immune responses to viral pathogens and on developing novel strategies for the prevention and treatment of infectious diseases. Our work combines cutting-edge immunology, virology, antibody engineering, and translational research approaches to address clinically relevant questions in viral infections.
This PhD project focuses on the investigation of AAV-based strategies to effectively target HIV-1 using broadly neutralizing antibodies. A central goal of the project is to develop novel approaches for enabling in vivo expression of bNAb combinations that overcome limitations of AAV packaging capacity. The project will involve the design and detailed characterization of multispecific bNAb-derived constructs, the in vivo validation of AAV-mediated protein expression, and the analysis of antiviral activity as well as viral evolution in HIV-1-infected humanized mouse models. The successful candidate will work in a highly collaborative environment with access to state-of-the-art laboratory infrastructure and clinical research networks.
Your work will contribute to a deeper understanding of antibody activity against HIV-1 as well as viral escape mechanisms, and support the development of innovative preventive and therapeutic strategies.
Applications from female candidates are expressly welcome and will be given priority in the event of equal suitability, competence and professional performance. People with disabilities are welcome to apply and will be treated preferentially in the event of equal suitability and qualification.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (f/m/d) - Life Science and Diagnostics (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About this opportunity

In the position of a (Junior) Software Engineer (f/m/d) in Life Science and Diagnostics at QIAGEN, you will be making improvements in life possible – every working day. We are looking for you to help us shape our product development with skill and passion. You will work with our system and software teams to develop instrument control software for laboratory devices as well as data analysis software to process test results helping our customers to get valuable insights from a biological sample.

Your Tasks
* As a Software Engineer you will typically work in project teams of 5-10 people and gain experience in different roles throughout the life cycle of a software development project.
* You will start as a software developer or (automated) software tester in one of our scrum teams. Throught your professional career you will have the opportunity to grow into senior roles such as senior engineer, product owner, software architect or verification manager.  
* You will work across teams and across sites to generate the best possible solution for our products in a complex environment of Biology, Chemistry, Mechanics, Electronics and Software.
* You will be based at QIAGEN Hilden, our operational headquarter and will have the opportunity to visit our international development sites in Aarhus, Denmark or Wroclaw, Poland to strengthen and refine your software development capabilities.

Your Profile
* You have a master’s degree in computer science, with a minor in medicine, science or engineering
* You show a strong interest in software and product development and have already gained first professional experience.
* You love science and have a strong analytical mindset that strives to analyze, understand and solve problems.
* You are highly organized, work independently and easily adapt to changing work environment.
* You show excellent communication skills in both, English and German (C1 level)
* Ideally, you are familiar with working with AI-powered development tools or large language models to automate software development lifecycle processes. Experience with connecting AI agents with third-party systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus

Please provide a transcript of record and an employer's reference if applicable.

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

Your responsibilities:

- As Media Partnership Coordinator you build and maintain strong relationships with media partners to increase brand awareness and attract existing and prospective B2B customers.
- You support the creation, formatting, and distribution of partner-related emails, newsletters, and follow-up communications using marketing tools and templates.
- Furthermore, you coordinate print advertising placements, assist with content submissions, and help ensure the smooth execution of media campaigns.
- The maintenance and updating media partner databases, monitoring partnership performance, and preparing reports and analyses on marketing activities belong to your regular tasks.
- You assist with budget tracking, invoice processing, and purchase orders to ensure marketing activities remain aligned with approved budgets.
- Also you support sponsorship initiatives, contribute to translations of media content and business documents, and compile press clippings and coverage reports on product launches and reviews.

You bring along:

- You bring at least 1 year of experience in marketing, media coordination, media planning, or a related field to the table, and are eager to develop your expertise in B2B marketing.
- You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and have hands-on experience with AI tools, newsletter platforms, social media channels, analytics, and reporting.
- By having strong analytical skills and know how to gather, evaluate, and interpret relevant data, identify trends, you turn insights into actionable recommendations.
- You work in a structured and organized manner, manage priorities effectively, and reliably meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
- Taking initiative, showing a proactive mindset, and being motivated to contribute beyond your core responsibilities to support team and business success is self-explanatory to you.
- You communicate confidently in English (minimum B2 level) and build positive relationships through strong collaboration, customer focus, and excellent written and verbal communication skills. Additional language skills are a strong advantage.

What we offer:

- A secure job in a constantly growing company
- A multinational team with colleagues from all over the world and an agreeable working atmosphere within the Powersports industry
- Flexible working times in full and part-time and modern working equipment.
- Onboarding and support for new employees
- Regular employee events, excursions, guided motorcycle tours and special sales events
- Company bike leasing and a job ticket for the regional public transport
- Company health management with organized health days, check-ups, group sport activities, contribution to fitness center membership fee, etc.

Are YOU interested?

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

We value diversity and therefore welcome applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity.

jobs.description:
At Native Nanny, we specialize in international childcare placements across Germany. We connect families with caring, qualified childcare professionals – and help nannies, babysitters, and tutors with international backgrounds find the right family match.

We are currently looking for experienced nannies, babysitters, and tutors to work with families in Duisburg and the surrounding areas. If you speak English, French, Italian, or another widely spoken language, we’d love to hear from you!

- You’re reliable, organized, and flexible in your schedule.

- Get matched with families that value your skills and background.
- Be part of a trusted network of international childcare professionals.

If you're passionate about childcare and want to make a difference in a family’s life, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now by submitting your CV directly on our website.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Native Nanny community!

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Join our dynamic team at Boehringer Ingelheim as a Customer Experience (CX) Head, TA. In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic linchpin, leveraging data to enrich decision-making and uncovering new business opportunities within the TA. Working in close collaboration with the TA Head and a standing member of the Brand Team, you will drive customer-centric initiatives for Human Pharma Germany. If you're passionate about shaping customer experiences and have a knack for strategic thinking, we'd love to hear from you.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As the primary point of contact, you will engage with the TA Head and Brand Team, acting as a strategic sparring partner.
- You will be responsible for converting strategic and high-level tactical features into smaller, actionable user stories.
- Strong capabilities for business case and LRR development by evaluating on-going operational requirement against existing resource and capabilities
- Integral analytical support for OL, ACV and LTF planning process and preparations on a strategic level
- Involvement in business cases and LRR development will be a key part of your role, as you evaluate ongoing operational requirements against existing resources and capabilities.
- Overall management and leadership of 4-6 direct reports (incl people development) for the functional areas related to Project Management, Training & Development, Customer Insights & Forecasting, and Sales Force Effectiveness.
- Establishing strategic and cooperative relationships with various functions within HP Business Operations and cross-functional teams will be a major part of your role.
- You will serve as a liaison between various functions and groups (Brand Team, HP Operations Group Heads and Squad Leads), influencing stakeholders to improve productivity, manage necessary changes, and support key business projects.
- Direct reporting line to Head of Human Pharma Operations, Human Pharma Germany.

Requirements

- Doctoral degree (e.g., PhD, MD) and/or a Master's degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) or diploma degree
- Possess experience in a leadership or people manager role, including in-depth knowledge of the German human pharmaceutical market
- Exhibit excellent relationship-building skills and conflict management with above-average oral, written, and presentation skills
- Demonstrate the ability to drive change, manage organizational transformations, and proactively implement innovation
- Have experience in Commercial (Sales and/or Marketing), Training, Business Analyst roles.
- Possess the ability to lead and steer different functions and can lead without authority within a TAs
- Be capable of simplifying complex topics and providing clear actionable next steps.
- Exhibit strength in being a solution-driven leader to address issues/challenges and lead the team to move forward together
- Possess strong people management skills - inspires and develops growth for team members

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until 18.09.2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to 11.09.2026 are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning of October
Please submit your application documents in English.

The Medical Faculty of Leipzig University, with its tradition spanning more than 600 years, is one of the largest research institutions in the Leipzig region. With over 1,300 employees, it is the largest of the university's 14 faculties and serves as a training center for approximately 3,500 students in human medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, and midwifery.

We are seeking a highly motivated Epidemiologist to design and conduct epidemiological research in pediatric populations, focusing on the determinants of child health, the development of common childhood diseases, particularly obesity, and the prevention and long-term outcomes of childhood obesity and metabolic diseases.
The research group "Childhood Obesity and Metabolic Research", led by Antje Körner, investigates the development, mechanisms and health consequences of childhood obesity. The translational approach combines experimental research, clinical studies and genetic approaches. Our international and interdisciplinary team is closely integrated with the research structures of the Medical Faculty of Leipzig University, Helmholtz Munich, and leading local as well as national research consortia, such as the Excellence cluster LeiCeM, the German Center for Child and Youth Health (DZKJ), and our large children's and adolescents' cohort LIFE Child.
We have large, well-characterized cohorts up and running with a longitudinal setting and across the entire age range: LIFE Child (n~6000), Leipzig Obesity Childhood Cohort (n~2500), and Leipzig Adipose Tissue Childhood cohort (n~700), with deep phenotyping allowing for combining clinical, epidemiological, lifestyle and functional omics and multi-omics data.
Key Responsibilities

- Design, plan, and conduct epidemiological research projects, including cohort and intervention studies.
- Develop study protocols and statistical analysis plans.
- Analyze and interpret complex population-based, clinical, and/or health-related datasets.
- Preparation of scientific manuscripts, reports, presentations, and grant applications.
- Ensure high standards of data quality, reproducibility, and compliance with ethical and data protection regulations.
- Present research findings at national and international conferences and scientific meetings.
- Provide methodological expertise and consultation to ongoing research projects; collaborate closely with clinicians, statisticians, bioinformaticians, and other researchers
- Supervision junior researchers or students.

Required Qualifications
Education: Candidates should have a Ph.D. and/or M.D. degree in: Epidemiology, Public Health, Biostatistics, Medicine, Health Sciences or a related discipline.
Professional Experience

- Experience in the design and implementation of epidemiological studies, large cohort studies.
- Experience working with large-scale health, clinical, or population-based datasets.
- Strong understanding of epidemiological study designs and methodologies.
- Experience with observational and interventional research.
- Experience in data cleaning, validation, and quality assurance.
- Familiarity with evidence-based medicine and public health principles.
- Track record of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals is desirable.
- Experience in interdisciplinary and collaborative research environments.
- Knowledge of research ethics and data protection requirements.
- Experience in grant writing is an advantage.
- Knowledge of causal inference methods (e.g., Target Trial Emulation, Mendelian Randomization) is desirable.

Statistical and Analytical Skills

- Proficiency in at least one statistical programming language such as: R, SAS, Stata, Python.
- Experience with general statistical methods:
- Regression modeling
- Longitudinal data analysis
- Missing data methods
- Sensitivity analyses
- Knowledge of modern analytical approaches, including machine learning methods, is an advantage.

Personal Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent organizational and project management abilities.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.
- Communication skills: English - excellent; German - very good

Candidates with one or more of the following areas of expertise are particularly encouraged to apply:

- Cohort studies
- Precision medicine and risk prediction modeling
- Multi-omics, biomarker, or biobank data integration
- Obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or metabolic health research
